title: Envelope
description: Common envelope of every event in a log stream (specification section 2.2).

at.description: The moment the event occurred, taken synchronously at the emission point.

thread.description: Opaque identifier of the emitting thread or task.

host.description: The node's name, unique within the cluster, constant for the run.

data.description: The payload; specified per namespace in observables.schema.json.
